example.title: WATER TEMPERATURE ON GROWTH AND LIPID METABOLISM IN CHINESE MANDARIN FISH

extract.quote: 在36℃养殖条件下, 雌雄鳜的WGR较28℃和35℃显著降低(P<0.05)。
extract.statement: 在36℃养殖条件下，雌雄鳜的增重率较28℃和35℃显著降低。

map.reason: The claim reports that high temperature (36°C) significantly reduces weight gain rate in mandarin fish compared to lower temperatures. This is a measured result from the study. While it addresses an environmental condition (temperature/water quality) relevant to welfare, the outcome reported is growth (a proxy for welfare/health), not a direct welfare metric like stress hormones or mortality. The reduction in growth indicates a negative impact on the animal's physiological state under that specific condition.

verify.note: WGR即增重率(Weight Gain Rate)，引文与陈述内容一致。

render.text_en: Under rearing conditions at 36°C, the weight gain rate of female and male mandarin fish was significantly lower than at 28°C and 35°C.

names: artificial temperature control with feeding management
name: water temperature control
水温控制
cluster.reason: All members concern managing or setting rearing water temperature (optimal range or extremes) for the fish, but claim C9269 is about small yellow croaker, not the target species, so it is dropped.

findings.statement_en: In mandarin fish, water temperature outside the suitable range harmed welfare: at 36°C growth was severely inhibited, liver antioxidant enzymes (SOD, CAT) and heat shock genes (hsp70, hsp90) fell while MDA rose, and early development was suppressed at temperatures too high or too low. Temperatures of about 23-27°C (best 25°C) gave good feeding, vigour and growth, though the claims cite different optimal ranges (25-35°C in one paper), and several claims only describe how temperature was controlled.
findings.statement_zh: 对鳜鱼来说，水温偏离适宜范围会损害其福利：36℃时生长受到严重抑制，肝脏抗氧化酶（SOD、CAT）和热休克基因（hsp70、hsp90）下降，MDA升高；水温过高或过低还会抑制早期发育。23-27℃（最适25℃）时摄食旺盛、活力好、生长快，不过各研究给出的适宜范围不完全一致（有研究称25-35℃），另有几条只是描述了控温方法。

strength.en: Of 18 claims that take a side: 4 in favour, 14 against or no effect. Neither side reaches 80%.
strength.zh: 18 条有明确倾向的论断中，4 条支持，14 条反对或无效果，任何一方都未达到 80%。
strength.rule: one paper; described if more claims describe than take a side; agree or against at 80% or more one way; otherwise mixed

basis.summary: Most weight rests on the measured high-temperature results from paper S023 (growth, antioxidant and heat shock markers) plus measured early-development results from paper S370; the optimal range differs between papers (25-35°C vs 23-27°C), so I noted that, and left out claims that only describe heating/cooling methods or other species.
